arguments.content: Pattern: future-provider test doubles conceal compatibility failures during independently released protocol upgrades. In enhanced-settings task 1, an unconditional client requirement for applied=True rejects ordinary successful saves from the supported eval-release provider, which persists values then returns only {ok: True}. The updated unit test supplies the future receipt response, so it passes despite the released contract failing. Review new mandatory response fields against the actual supported release, not merely candidate provider behavior; preserve legacy success until provider support is established, and cover legacy and receipt-capable responses. P1, isolated code review, client.py:5; source-confirmed by independent reviewer and reproduced by main agent against the local release snapshot.
